title: JDBC connects to the wrong host port
root_cause: The PostgreSQL service exposes container port 5432 on runner port 5544, while the JDBC URL uses localhost port 5432. Point the JDBC URL at localhost:5544 or change the published port to match.

relevant_evidence.why: The service publishes PostgreSQL on host port 5544.
The JDBC URL instead uses port 5432.
The JDBC connection to port 5432 is refused.
